description: This file is a BitBake include (.inc) file defining build configurations, dependencies, and options for building WPE WebKit within a Yocto Project environment. It specifies dependencies, build options, features, and other metadata, acting as a configuration script rather than traditional source code.

methods.name: do_add_version
methods.description: Defines a function to record the version of the WPE WebKit package into a text file within the build's extra versions path.
